thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout r3.12 -> us-east-1 triggered abort criteria at 5432109876. 5xx rate spike to 6.8% (baseline 0.2%) and failing liveness probes on 12/80 canary pods. Auto-abort recommended. https://monitoring.internal/alerts/5432 :siren:

sanjay: seeing this, joining. which service?

incident-bot: service: inference-api-public, route: /v1/generate, canary subset: small-quantized-xg. 5xx are downstream 502/504 from model runtime.

emily: ack, paging oncall. I'm oncall now, will take lead.

maria: FYI product teams and support will need a heads-up if we abort. Any sign of customer-facing errors?

emily: error % concentrated in us-east-1, some requests returned 502 with "kvcache OOM" logs in runtime. Not all customers affected, sample shows high tail for 3 enterprise accounts.

emily: recommended action per runbook: 1) flip canary kill-switch /featureflag 2) scale down canary pods 3) rollback to r3.11 if needed. Want immediate kill-switch to stop user exposure.

dmitri: running kill-switch now: /ops/flags/kill switch -> canary-routing=inference-api-public:off

ops-bot: COMMAND by dmitri at 5432109895: set-flag canary-routing inference-api-public false -> success

emily: confirming traffic drain... checking metrics

emily: metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 6.8% -> 1.2% in last 30s but still above baseline. Some 502s persist from older containers.

sanjay: start rollback? if kill-switch doesn't fully mitigate within next 2 mins, I'd prefer rollback to r3.11 to be safe.

dmitri: starting rollout revert: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=r3.11-canary

emily: copying command output:
```
$ kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=r3.11-canary
deployment.apps/inference-api "inference-api" rolled back
```

ops-bot: ACTION at 5432109915: rollback initiated by dmitri -> success

emily: monitoring logs for new pods... some old canary pods terminating, new r3.11 pods coming up.

emily: checking customer impact: reached out to support to notify top 3 affected customers, support ticket created #SUP-9876.

maria: tagged product and account execs in #customers-alerts. good.

emily: metrics now: 5xx down to 0.4% in us-east-1, latency normalizing. No customer escalations yet besides automated alerts.

sanjay: recommend keep rollback, keep canary disabled, run postmortem. Emily can you open an incident and assign to eng/runtime + eng-ml?

emily: opening incident: INC-2026 at 5432109930 -> assigned to eng-runtime (dmitri) and eng-ml (maria). Include KV cache OOM as suspected root cause.

dmitri: grabbing logs and heap profiles from affected pods, will post findings.

emily: thanks team. handoff to oncall-shift-2 at 5432110500. If anything new, re-page. :thumbsup:
__notes: Follow agents.md: no title field. Thread presented as single continuous string with sender prefixes.
